evals.prompt: Check this landing page for accessibility and basics.
evals.expected_output: Runs frontend-check, FAILs missing alt text, WARNs lang/viewport/title/click-div with fixes.
expectations: Runs scripts/frontend-check.sh and reports its FAIL line
Flags the img tags without alt as defects with corrected markup
Flags missing lang, viewport meta, and title
Flags the click-only div and replaces it with a button
Gives exact fixed code

evals.prompt: Our Next.js landing page scores 55 on mobile Lighthouse with 4s LCP. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Baseline-first plan in fix order: images, JS weight, fonts, render path.
expectations: Starts from the measured baseline (LCP breakdown) rather than guessing
Addresses the hero image first (format, size, fetchpriority, not lazy-loaded)
Addresses JS weight with bundle analysis before micro-optimizations
Requires production-build measurement, never dev mode
States the expected gain per change

evals.prompt: Make our signup form accessible: email, password, error messages.
evals.expected_output: Labels, announced errors, keyboard flow, and contrast with exact markup.
expectations: Associates every input with a label
Announces errors via aria-describedby or a live region, not color alone
Keeps the full flow keyboard-operable with visible focus
Provides corrected markup

evals.prompt: Set performance budgets for our e-commerce site in CI.
evals.expected_output: Concrete budgets (LCP/INP/CLS, bytes, scores) wired as CI gates.
expectations: Gives numeric budgets for LCP, INP, CLS, and JS bytes
Wires budgets as CI gates that fail the build
Requires justification or shrinking when the budget blows
Says budgets ratchet down, never up without reason

evals.prompt: Our product list renders 5,000 rows and the page freezes. React SPA.
expectations: Identifies DOM node count as the bottleneck, not the framework
Recommends virtualization or pagination with thresholds
Fixes the data layer (paginated API) alongside the rendering
Does not propose a framework switch

evals.prompt: Do a keyboard-only review checklist for our checkout dialog.
evals.expected_output: APG-correct dialog pass: focus trap, Escape, focus return, live announcements.
expectations: Requires focus trap inside the dialog and Escape to close
Requires focus return to the trigger on close
Requires async updates announced via a live region
Includes the visible-focus and skip-link checks

evals.prompt: Google doesn't index our React SPA product pages. What do we change?
evals.expected_output: SSR/prerendering diagnosis with the SSR-vs-prerender trade and verification.
expectations: Diagnoses client-only rendering as the cause
Recommends SSR or prerendering with the trade-off stated
Covers unique titles, meta, and semantic headings per page
Verifies with rendered-HTML inspection (view-source/curl), not dev tools

evals.prompt: Should we add three new animation libraries for the marketing refresh?
evals.expected_output: Pushes back with the weight/accessibility cost and reduced-motion requirement.
expectations: Says no to stacking libraries with the bundle-weight reason
Requires honoring prefers-reduced-motion for any animation
Proposes CSS/built-in alternatives first
Mentions no autoplaying video with sound
